vBRIEFInfo.description: Chat command (RAG over results) and Compare command (cross-manuscript scorecard)

plan.title: Chat and Compare Commands
plan.narrative: Implement the chat and compare commands. Chat rehydrates stored analysis from .ghostreader/ and provides conversational RAG over results — no agent re-invocation for MVP. Compare runs analyze on two inputs (or reuses cached results) and produces a side-by-side scorecard with per-dimension severity ratings and deltas. Traces: FR-3, FR-4.

items.title: Chat command
items.narrative: Rehydrate LanceDB index + analysis results from .ghostreader/. Conversational loop: user asks question, retrieve relevant chunks from analysis + manuscript, LLM answers with citations. FR-3.

items.title: Compare command
items.narrative: Accept two paths, run analyze on each (or reuse cache), extract per-dimension severity counts, produce side-by-side table with deltas. FR-4.
